topic: Anthropic CEO reportedly worried new hires only care about money
headline: Are Engineers Just After Money?
caption: As a full stack engineer, I see how compensation can sometimes overshadow passion for impactful work. While earning well is important, the best teams thrive when driven by innovation and purpose. Companies should foster environments where curiosity and growth matter just as much as paychecks. It’s a balance - salary is essential, but so is creating opportunities that inspire us to code smarter and build better solutions. Let’s keep striving for workplaces that value both. 💻✨ #softwaredevelopment #techculture #careerinsights
